tool_args.rationale: The five fixed-horizon observations do not validate the Hill-inhibition law, and fresh confirmation strongly refutes it. Since the observed signatures are smooth and sink-gradient dependent rather than chaotic, use the low-cost open-branch probe to distinguish competing branch mechanisms before fitting a revised model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation RMSE 2.364 is far above tolerance 0.045, so the current four-parameter mechanism is refuted.
The evidence does not point to a coupled-memory ODE; this costly batch is not the most targeted discriminator.
It is explicitly nuisance data and would not resolve the mechanism or branch ambiguity.
The stationary model family has not been exhausted; an open-branch probe can discriminate plausible branch mechanisms.
